init_lazy_modules: init lazy modules in a PyTorch model by passing a dummy input tensor to infer dimensions
create_Lazy_module: create a Lazy PyTorch module that infers input dimensions from the first forward pass
create_Infer_dimension: create an Infer object that resolves a specific tensor dimension for lazy module construction
replace_lazy_modules: replace all Lazy submodules in a PyTorch model with their resolved concrete module instances
create_lazy_property: create a lazy property descriptor that evaluates an object attribute only on first access
